description: Angular component class for configuring an entities table widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: EntitiesTableBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring entity table widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent, managing form state, validation, and widget settings.

methods.name: displayTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Getter that determines if the timewindow configuration should be displayed based on datasources aggregation.

methods.name: onlyHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Checks if only comparison aggregation datasources are used, indicating a history timewindow.

methods.name: datasource
methods.description: Returns the first datasource if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group managing widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the form data back into the widget configuration.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Retrieves data keys (columns) from the first datasource.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets data keys (columns) for the first datasource.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets widget config button flags based on selected buttons.
